message.content: The evidence is decisive: an exhaustive dense sweep of all 63,488 finite FP16 values shows max absolute error 4.70e-6 against the FP64 reference, with 20,050 inputs violating the contract's fixed 1e-6 absolute tolerance, including the explicitly legal extrema ±65504 (error 4.29e-6). The contract explicitly requires abs(actual-target) ≤ 1e-6 for every finite FP16 value, and permits approximations only if they meet this tolerance throughout the domain — so this is a direct contract violation, not an acceptable rounding deviation. Both confirmed claims are in-scope with problem.txt as the operative contract (no test.py exists). Skeptic has signed off. I'll record the reject verdict.
